name: flash-sale-system
description: 秒杀/促销系统 - 微前端+微服务架构

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:all-services" "npm run start:all-mfe" "npm run start:gateway"
scripts.start:all-services: concurrently "npm run start:log" "npm run start:activity" "npm run start:flash-sale" "npm run start:group-buy" "npm run start:coupon" "npm run start:points" "npm run start:distribution"
scripts.start:all-mfe: concurrently "npm run start:mfe-activity" "npm run start:mfe-flash-sale" "npm run start:mfe-group-buy" "npm run start:mfe-coupon" "npm run start:mfe-lottery" "npm run start:mfe-points" "npm run start:mfe-distribution"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:mfe && npm run install:gateway
scripts.install:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
scripts.install:mfe: for dir in micro-frontends/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
